title: Is the Web Ready for AI Search to Take Over?
excerpt: Looking at how AI search is changing the web, what challenges remain, and whether we're ready for a new era of information discovery.

blocks.text: For nearly three decades, search meant typing keywords and scanning blue links. Today, conversational reasoning synthesizes answers directly, fundamentally rewriting user interaction patterns across the web.

When search engines answer questions without requiring a click, the open web's ad-supported economic model experiences profound strain. Attribution, citations, and content licensing agreements must evolve rapidly.
High-quality original analysis, primary reporting, and distinctive personal voice will always command an audience, even when summaries are automated.
blocks.author: Ishara Udayaga

blocks.text: Rather than generic SEO compilations, high-signal personal journals and specialized engineering blogs will become the true bastions of credible knowledge on the internet.
